statute.name: Orinth Criminal Code 2026
elements: The accused intended to kill the fictional head of government.
The accused took an act that went beyond mere preparation.
The accused intended the attack to intimidate the public or coerce the fictional government for an ideological purpose.

agreed_facts: The First Convenor was scheduled to speak at Neryn Hall at 14:30.
The safety drill had been cancelled and Sera opened the cancellation notice.
A functional handgun and ammunition were recovered from the sealed case; no person was injured.
disputed_facts: Whether Sera knew what the sealed case contained.
Whether her acts went beyond preparation with an intention to kill.
Whether any intended attack had the charged ideological purpose.

best_case.prosecution: Sera deliberately recreated cancelled access, disguised the case, and positioned it at the marked speaking point as part of an ideological attempt to kill the Convenor.
best_case.defence: Sera followed a confused technical handover, believed the sealed case held optics, and used familiar rehearsal materials without knowing a weapon was inside.

foundations.provenance: Pellen personally saw Sera present the green card and heard her describe a Convenor-route check.
foundations.authentication: Pellen identified the card practice and his own floor marker from prior rehearsals.
foundations.custody_and_integrity: The green card was recovered from Sera and recorded with the sealed case.
foundations.admissibility: First-hand observations and Sera's own words are admitted to prove conduct and intention.
foundations.limitations: The same card had once been legitimate and the floor marker could also serve lighting work.

foundations.provenance: Doctor Dorr compared the label and card sentence with uncontested work notes.
foundations.authentication: The examiner described the comparison material, method, and degree of correspondence.
foundations.custody_and_integrity: Davi documented the case label and card before the exhibits were submitted for comparison.
foundations.admissibility: The qualified handwriting opinion is admitted with its stated limits.
foundations.limitations: The label opinion is strong but not certain; the card opinion is moderate and the sentence cannot be dated closely.

foundations.provenance: Davi photographed the intact numbered seal and opened the case with another officer present.
foundations.authentication: He identified the recovered case, seal, handgun, and inventory history from his own work.
foundations.custody_and_integrity: The case remained sealed until the documented safety-room opening.
foundations.admissibility: The physical observations and custody evidence are admitted.
foundations.limitations: The intact seal and absence of Sera's trace do not establish that she knew the handgun was inside.

foundations.provenance: Pellen answered from his recollection of public meetings.
foundations.authentication: No further authentication was reached because the exchange was stopped.
foundations.custody_and_integrity: No record was tendered through this exchange.
foundations.admissibility: The court excluded the entire exchange as irrelevant propensity reasoning.
foundations.limitations: The jury must give the exchange no weight for guilt, purpose, or credibility.

alternative_innocent_inference: A chaotic technical handover led Sera to retrieve a familiar sealed optics-style case, relabel it from an instruction she misunderstood, and carry it to a location serving both lighting and the Convenor route without knowing a handgun was inside.
required_directions: The prosecution must prove every element beyond reasonable doubt; Sera proves nothing.
An attempt requires an act beyond mere preparation together with the intention to kill.
Terrorist purpose requires an intention to intimidate the public or coerce government for an ideological end.
Lawful advocacy and the excluded public-meeting exchange must not be used as evidence of guilt or purpose.
Consider each record and observation only within its stated foundation and limitation.

checks.victim_humanity: The Convenor and public are treated as people affected by a prevented threat, without weapon spectacle or graphic detail.
checks.accused_prejudice: The script excludes lawful advocacy and punishment consequences from the jury's decision.
